modelAssumptions: Active auras cover the enemies being scored and the XP recipient is within Veteran range. Archer coverage is 100% of scored boss rewards by default, not 100% of arbitrary wave trash.
One provider per named XP ability, confirmed by the user. Prefer a skill-tiled copy; duplicates retain their separate milestones and synergies but do not multiply the same named ability.

Archer's marked boss reward factor is (3 + 0.2 × effective Skill Power) × (1 + wave × masteryPercentPerWave / 100). Coverage weights this reward against an ordinary unmarked kill. The captured +13,240% mark gives 652 no-tile Skill Power. The 20% tile projects 782 from the rounded capture; account wave mastery uses the captured rate on every tile.
Ballista's active aura and stacked mastery are separate reward factors. The skill tile boosts the active aura via owner Skill Power. Mastery uses account Mastery Power.
Archer and Ballista reward factors are distinct from displayed additive Rank EXP and from each other. They apply once to the kill payout before Veteran sharing.
Default Ballista and Veteran stacks are 100 for warmed-up farming; Ballista's captured 68-stack state can be entered explicitly.
Veteran's entry uses 1626/100 for its per-stack mastery amount. Its active Super EXP and share chances use rounded Skill Power contributions. The skill tile boosts these active chances.
Share chance is capped at one shared award. Only Super/Ultra EXP chances feed the EXP spillover pool. No XP ability feeds Gold or Damage spillover.

The model uses the editable no-tile tooltips throughout a comparison. The game's pre-round Skill Power and changes across rosters or levels are not captured. Skill tiles scale the active Skill Power components. The mastery factors retain the account capture.
Cooldown controls tagging/uptime, not a direct payout multiplier. The farming model assumes regular enemies/bosses, not Training Dummy mastery reductions.
